title: Multi-Symptom Cascade — dc1-leaf2a Ethernet1 Maintenance
symptom: Fabric-wide: dc1-spine1 BGP neighbor down, dc1-leaf2a EVPN routes withdrawn, VTEP tunnel down, VLAN 11 hosts unreachable. Change ticket NOC-CR-982 open.
root_cause: Ethernet1 on dc1-leaf2a shutdown as part of planned maintenance (NOC-CR-982). Single interface shutdown cascades into 5 simultaneous alerts.
